title: EV Charging Cost by Session
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT bridges.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:charge
| eval kwh=energy_added_kwh, cost=round(kwh*tariff_per_kwh,2)
| stats sum(kwh) as total_kwh, sum(cost) as total_cost, count as sessions by location
| eval avg_cost_per_session=round(total_cost/sessions,2)
| sort - total_cost
description: Adds up the energy and money spent charging at each location so you can see whether home, work, or public charging is costing you the most.
value: Charging cost is invisible when it is spread across a power bill; attributing it per location reveals where to shift charging to save real money.
implementation: Ingest charge sessions with energy added and your tariff; schedule weekly and compare cost per location.
visualization: Table and bar chart of charging cost by location.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up what it costs to charge your car in different places, so you can charge where it is cheapest.
